Comparison

A Free PDF to Word Alternative to iLovePDF

iLovePDF is a large, well-known suite with dozens of PDF tools. If all you need is to convert PDF to Word, here's how PDF2Wordly compares as a simpler, focused option.

On this page

  • What to look for

What people usually look for in a PDF to Word tool

When the task is just "turn this PDF into an editable Word document," most people care about a handful of things: is it free, does it require an account, does it leave a watermark, how accurate is the conversion, and does it handle scanned documents as well as digital ones.

How PDF2Wordly compares

iLovePDF is a full suite: merging, splitting, editing, e-signatures, workflows, and more, alongside PDF to Word. PDF2Wordly does one thing — PDF ⇄ Word conversion — and keeps the process short.

PDF2Wordly iLovePDF
Focus PDF to Word conversion, including scanned PDFs Full PDF suite (merge, split, edit, sign, and more)
Account needed? Yes, a free account Optional, required for some features
OCR languages English, French, Arabic Available as a separate OCR tool
Price Free, with a daily limit; Pro removes it Free tier available; Premium for full access

If you need more than PDF to Word — editing, e-signatures, or workflow automation — a full suite like iLovePDF makes more sense. If PDF to Word is all you're after, PDF2Wordly gets you there in fewer steps.

Convert PDF to Word in 3 steps

  1. Upload your PDF. Drag it in or choose it from your device after signing in to your free account.
  2. Convert. The tool rebuilds the text, layout, and formatting as an editable document.
  3. Download. Save the .docx file and open it in Word, Google Docs, or any compatible app.

Frequently asked questions

Is PDF2Wordly the same as iLovePDF?

No. iLovePDF is a broad suite covering dozens of PDF tools, from merging and editing to e-signatures. PDF2Wordly focuses specifically on converting PDF files to Word, including scanned documents with OCR.

Do I need to create an account to convert PDF to Word?

Yes. A free account is required: sign in, then upload a PDF and download the converted Word file.

Does PDF2Wordly support scanned PDFs like iLovePDF's OCR tool?

Yes. Scanned or image-only PDFs are converted using built-in OCR, with support for English, French, and Arabic text.

Is PDF2Wordly free to use?

Yes, converting PDF to Word is free, with a daily conversion limit. A Pro plan allows up to 100 files per day and up to 200 pages per file.
